notes:
⚠️ JAVASCRIPT REQUIRED: This site uses Business Brokers CRM platform with custom <bbcrm> tags that load listings dynamically via JavaScript. The static HTML contains only placeholder tags like <bbcrm api_string="searchresults"></bbcrm> with no actual listing data. 

REQUIREMENTS:
- Requires Playwright/Selenium/Puppeteer for JavaScript rendering
- After JS execution, listings should populate within or after the bbcrm tags
- The actual container and field selectors will need to be determined after JS renders the content

PLATFORM: Business Brokers CRM (businessbrokerscrm.com)
BROKER TYPE: Pharmacy-focused broker specializing in pharmacy sales nationwide

To scrape this site, use a headless browser that executes JavaScript, wait for the BBCRM API to load listings, then inspect the DOM to determine the actual selectors used for listing containers and fields.
